title: Semester and Mixtape
author: Lior Brightwater
blurb: Mirabel Villalobos, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
